_about: Off-the-shelf actuators we can buy (RobStride QDD modules). Peak torque, no-load speed (+-10 %), mass and gear from RobStride's Product_Information spec table of 2026-07-13 (github.com/RobStride/Product_Information). rated_nm from each module's manual (section 1.2), where it differs from that table: RS03 20 not 21, RS02 6 not 7. Sizes from the maker's STEP files of 2026-10-30, read as edges and circles and checked against their CIRCLE radii: 'h' the length along the output including the hub, 'r' the half of the largest round envelope, ears and connector bump included, 'depth' the fore-aft size with the ears turned to their best (RS03, RS06) in a limb where only one direction is tight. The motors stay simple cylinders: r where they turn or sit in the open, depth / 2 where the ears are turned (the ankle). 'rating_note' gives the plate each rating needs, and the stall figures, which are one reader's reading of each manual's second overload chart: confirm on the bench. 'ratio' > 1 means an extra linkage reduction after the module (torque x ratio, speed / ratio). Joint dynamics (tools/make_robot_files.py; 2026-10-31 ESTIMATES: RobStride publishes no rotor inertia in its spec tables; K-Bot's MJCF uses 0.005 / 0.0015 / 0.005 / 0.007 kg m2 armature on RS00 / 02 / 03 / 04, tuned values up to 5 x from ours): 'gear' the module's reduction, 'rotor_kgm2' the motor rotor's inertia, scaled from the frame size against Unitree's 7520 motor (5e-5 kg m2, from G1's armature 0.0102 at 14.3:1); reflected at the output as armature = rotor x gear^2; 'damping_nms' viscous and 'friction_nm' Coulomb friction at the output, typical of QDD modules (friction about 2-3 % of peak torque).

RS02.rating_note: 6 N m on a 260 x 280 mm plate (manual); 7 in its overload table

RS03.rating_note: 20 N m on a 215 x 220 mm plate (manual); about 13 at stall. T-N curve ends at 188 rpm under load

RS06.rating_note: 11 N m on a 130 x 160 mm plate (manual); about 8 at stall. T-N curve ends at 430 rpm under load

RS04.rating_note: 40 N m on 345 x 345 mm, 35 on 220 x 200 mm (spec table, at 50 rpm); about 28.5 at stall. T-N curve ends at 190 rpm under load
